english_outline.section1: AMD reported Q3 2026 revenue of USD 13.4 billion, up 45% year over year, driven by record Data Center revenue. Reuters reported the results and forecast beat estimates, easing AI spending fears.
english_outline.section2: Data Center revenue jumped 97% to a record USD 8.55 billion. Client and Gaming revenue fell 8% to USD 3.72 billion. AMD expects PC unit shipments to decline double digits in 2027. CEO Lisa Su said 80% of 2027 sales will come from data-center chips.
english_outline.section3: AMD guided Q4 2026 revenue to about USD 17 billion, above LSEG consensus of USD 16.23 billion. Adjusted gross margin expected around 55%, down from 56% in Q3. CEO forecast 2027 revenue growth above 80%, exceeding LSEG analyst estimate of 77%.
english_outline.section4: Reuters reported AMD shares rose 8% in extended trading after the forecast. Portfolio manager Hendi Susanto of Gabelli Funds said the stock's resilience suggests investors see AMD confirming technology leadership. TECHnalysis Research analyst Bob O'Donnell said AMD numbers provide a boost for AI infrastructure and the PC market.
english_outline.section5: The Helios rack, combining MI455X accelerator and Venice server chips, is in production and set for larger ramp-up in Q4, with initial systems tested at Meta. Q4 data-center revenue and Helios ramp execution are the key business validation points.

reader_questions: AMD 2026Q3财报后，市场对AI支出放缓的担忧是否被完全打消？
数据中心业务的高增长能否持续，并如何影响AMD的长期盈利结构？
AMD股价在财报后上涨，但后续出现的中国关联审查报道是否改变了市场预期？
checks: 核查来源：路透社报道称AMD的业绩与指引为AI热潮并未消退提供了有力反证，并缓解了投资者对AI支出放缓的担忧，但并未声称担忧被完全打消。修订稿应表述为“缓解”而非“消除”。
核查来源：路透社报道数据中心收入同比跃升97%至85.5亿美元，苏姿丰预计2027年80%销售额来自数据中心芯片，且第四季度营收指引约170亿美元。这些数据支持增长持续性的讨论，但需注意客户与游戏业务下滑及PC出货量预期下降的风险。
核查来源：路透社2026年11月19日报道AMD股价因中国关联可能引发美国审查而下滑。原稿未提及此后续事件，修订稿应补充该信息，以完整反映财报后市场定价的变化。
